parameters.help_en: The ID of the DRDS instance
parameters.name: drds_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the DRDS database
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: The start time for executing the flashback SQL
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time for executing the flashback SQL
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The trace ID of the flashback SQL
parameters.name: trace_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the table on which the flashback SQL operation is performed
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en: The type of SQL statement. Valid values: INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE. Separate multiple values with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: SQL的类型，取值范围为INSERT、UPDATE、DELETE，多种类型间用英文逗号（,）分隔

parameters.help_en: The primary key of the flashback SQL
parameters.name: sql_pk

parameters.help_en:
The match type. Valid values:
* 0: exact match.
* 1: fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh:
精确匹配或者模糊匹配，取值范围如下：
* 0：精确匹配
* 1：模糊匹配
parameters.name: recall_type

parameters.help_en:
The restore type. Valid values:
* 1: image restore.
* 0: reverse restore
parameters.help_zh:
恢复类型，取值范围如下：
